theorems.name: Submission.rsod_regularSet_meets_ball
theorems.statement: AllardRegularityTheorem → ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (p : ℝ), (n : ℝ) < p → V.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature H → V.LocallyLp H p → (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, x ∈ V.support → ∃ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k ∧ V.mult x = k) → ∀ ξ ∈ V.support, ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → (V.regularSet ∩ ball ξ r).Nonempty
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
